note: FuturePath editable default assumptions. These are illustrative teaching defaults for categories where no locality-level public dataset is used. Every one can be changed in the Assumptions drawer and is labeled 'assumption' in results.

healthcareMonthlyPerAdult.label: Health insurance share + out-of-pocket (per adult)
healthcareMonthlyPerAdult.note: Employee share of employer premiums plus typical out-of-pocket costs; varies widely by employer and plan.

otherMonthlyPerPerson.label: Clothing, personal care, household items (per person)

transitMonthlyPerAdult.label: Public transit (per adult, when no car)

childcareMonthlyPerChild.label: Childcare (per child in care)
childcareMonthlyPerChild.note: Full-time childcare prices vary a lot by city, age and type of care.

propertyTaxPct.label: Property tax
propertyTaxPct.note: Property tax rates differ by county and city.

ownerUtilitiesMonthly.label: Utilities for homeowners
ownerUtilitiesMonthly.note: Renters' benchmarks are gross rents that already include utilities.

presets.note: Lifestyle levels scale the editable assumptions above (house: the metro median home value). They are illustrative teaching levels, not quotes.

cozy.label: Cozy
cozy.examples: 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, small yard. A typical starter home.

standard.label: Standard
standard.examples: 4 bedrooms, 2-car garage, family room, bigger yard.

luxurious.label: Luxurious
luxurious.examples: 5 bedrooms, pool, home office, chef's kitchen.

mansion.label: Mansion
mansion.examples: 6+ bedrooms, gated, home theater, guest house.

compact.label: Compact
compact.examples: Toyota Corolla, Honda Civic, Hyundai Elantra

standard.label: Standard
standard.examples: Toyota Camry, Honda CR-V, Ford Escape

luxury.label: Luxury
luxury.examples: BMW 5 Series, Lexus RX, Mercedes-Benz GLE

low.label: Low-end
low.examples: A relative or a small in-home daycare

high.label: High-end
high.examples: A premium center or a nanny share

local.label: Local getaways
local.examples: Beach weekend, camping, theme park, visiting family

usa.label: Travel within the USA
usa.examples: A week in New York City, the Grand Canyon, Disney World or Hawaii

cruise.label: Cruises
cruise.examples: 3 to 7 nights in the Caribbean, Mexico or Alaska

world.label: Travel the world
world.examples: 1 to 2 weeks in Europe, Japan or on safari
